applies_to: accepted links of a limosat_trajectory_link_qc_v2_20260907 release (scientific edge Parquet)
decision_unit: one drift vector between consecutive keypoints within a v2 QC trajectory
neighbour_model: v2 neighbour model unchanged: accepted links of the exact same source/target image pair, leave-one-out, up to 24 neighbours within 30 km, at least 8, robust distance-weighted local affine with the v2 prediction guard; single pass

diagnostics.local_residual_m: distance between the link displacement and the v2 local-affine prediction; evaluated wherever the residual bound (coarse residual + 2 x largest neighbour deviation) reaches residual_floor_m
diagnostics.coarse_residual_m: distance from the median displacement of the same neighbours
diagnostics.neighbour_spread_m: median distance of the neighbour displacements from their own median
diagnostics.n_corroborating: neighbours closer to the link displacement than to the neighbour median and closer than half the coarse residual

exclusions.R1: local fit supported, local_residual_m > residual_floor_m, coherence_ratio >= coherence_min, n_corroborating == 0, source and target directly matched
exclusions.LAND: start or end point >= land_margin_km inside land on the supplied inland-distance raster

flags.bit_0_ISOLATED_INTERP: R1 conditions with an interpolated endpoint
flags.bit_1_INTERP_RESIDUAL: an interpolated endpoint and local_residual_m > residual_floor_m
flags.bit_2_PAIR_INCOHERENT: image pair with >= incoherent_min_links links of which >= incoherent_fraction have coarse_residual_m > incoherent_residual_m
flags.bit_3_OPEN_WATER: SIC < open_water_sic at both endpoints (nearest daily NOAA/NSIDC CDR v6 cell on the start and end dates); 0 when no SIC root is given
flags.bit_4_COASTAL: start or end point inside land by less than land_margin_km

split_semantics.rows_deleted: excluded links are removed from the edge table and listed with reason codes in the exclusion table
split_semantics.rule: a kept link starts a new segment after every excluded link of its v2 trajectory; flags never split
split_semantics.new_ids: segment 0 keeps qc_trajectory_id; later segments get deterministic integers above the period's maximum qc_trajectory_id, ordered by (qc_trajectory_id, excluded-link start time)
split_semantics.unchanged_columns: all v2 columns, including is_last, stopped and converged_to, are carried unchanged and describe the v2 trajectory

checks: edge_uid unique and disjoint between kept and excluded
zero continuity violations within v3 trajectories
